enable.description: Opt-in per host. Intended for config/android/hosts/<host>.json only, not base.json.

guiSdkSymlink.description: Symlink ~/Library/Android/sdk to the Nix-managed SDK root.

jdkPackage.description: nixpkgs attribute name for the JDK package (e.g. jdk, jdk17).

platformVersions.description: Android API levels to include (e.g. ["35"]). Default: ["34", "35"].

systemImageTypes.description: System image types to include (google_apis or google_apis_playstore). Default: ["google_apis_playstore"].

abiVersions.description: ABIs to include. Default: ["arm64-v8a"] (sufficient for Apple Silicon).
